panels.absencesDescription: Hours logged here for monthly-paid employees are converted to a pre-tax "Absence Deduction" amount when the payroll run is generated, using each employee's standard hours per month — deducted from basic salary before PAYE, the reverse of Overtime.
panels.adHocDescription: These will appear in payslips when the payroll run is submitted. You can edit the amount and remarks, or delete entries as needed.
panels.leaveEncashmentDescription: Employer-bought leave days. Each entry pays out as a taxable "Leave Encashment" allowance on this period's payslip and deducts the days bought from the employee's leave balance for the year. Deleting an entry restores the days.
panels.overtimeDescription: Hours logged here for monthly-paid employees are converted to an "Overtime Pay" amount when the payroll run is generated, using each employee's standard hours per month and the selected overtime type's multiplier.

upload.instructions: Download the template, fill in the adjustments, and upload the file. Each row represents one adjustment for an employee. Re-uploading will overwrite matching entries based on (period, employee, type).
upload.title: Upload Adjustments

add.intro: Add one row per employee, then save them all at once. Each row automatically logs a matching deduction in this same period to recover it — no separate step needed. A row with a problem (e.g. an employee already paid an advance this period) is skipped and reported — it won't block the others.
add.title: Add Advances

markPaid.intro: This marks every not-yet-paid advance uploaded for this period as paid, without posting a payment to the books.
markPaid.referencePlaceholder: e.g. Cash handed over, mobile money batch #4521
markPaid.title: Mark Advances as Paid

pay.intro: This pays every not-yet-paid advance uploaded for this period in one batch — one payment, crediting the account below.
pay.title: Pay Advances

reversePayment.content: This deletes the payment and its journals, and puts every advance it covered back to unpaid so the batch can be corrected and re-paid. Continue?

upload.instructions: Download the template, fill in the employees and amounts, and upload the file. Re-uploading will overwrite an employee's unpaid advance for this period rather than duplicating it.
